visual.description: Full-viewport overlay with a centered modal dialog containing a cookie policy text block and three equally-spaced CTA buttons arranged in a single row.
Top bar split into three zones: left-aligned text links (UNITED STATES, CONTACT US, SERVICES), centered Cartier script logo, and right-aligned icon cluster (wishlist, account, store locator, cart).
Single row of evenly distributed category navigation links (HIGH JEWELRY through LA MAISON) with a search icon anchored to the far right, separated by a vertical divider.
Full-bleed background image of a woman wearing jewelry, partially obscured by the modal overlay, with no visible text overlay in the visible portion.
